title: ownshot — dated proof of your own product photos for Etsy sellers wrongly flagged
oneLiner: For handmade Etsy sellers whose photos get copied and whose listings are then auto-flagged under Creativity Standards, it keeps independently timestamped originals per listing and builds an appeal-ready packet for $9 or $12 a month.
overlaps: none (Open-Travel, giftlet and alterpaw are unrelated; closest idea in the record is proofpack, a passed Stripe-dispute evidence packet)
